title: PLAG IN client-harness compatibility
scope: Compatibility with the bounded text protocols implemented by PLAG IN 0.1.0a2. This is not a ranking of model quality, safety, speed or general client capability.

ranking_method.axis: Recorded progress towards an installed client exchange with PLAG IN 0.1.0a2
ranking_method.tie_rule: Entries with the same recorded status share a competition rank.
ranking_method.limits: No installed client completed a verified end-to-end integration in the cited evidence. The order does not compare model quality, client quality, latency, throughput, memory use or safety.

entries.name: Odysseus fixture
entries.observed_boundary: Discovery and path logic were exercised, but urllib rather than the Odysseus HTTP client issued the request.

entries.name: Codex CLI
entries.observed_boundary: The client sent tools and the bounded Responses subset returned typed HTTP 501.

entries.name: Claude Code
entries.observed_boundary: The client requested the unimplemented Anthropic Messages route.

entries.name: Gemini CLI, legacy
entries.observed_boundary: The client refused its authentication configuration before issuing a request.

entries.name: Antigravity CLI
entries.observed_boundary: No route or HTTP status was reported. Whether a request reached PLAG IN is unassessed.
